map.推理吞吐估算器，由生成 token 数与端到端时延估算大模型推理吞吐(token: Inference throughput estimator: estimate the inference throughput of a large model (tokens/s) from the number of generated tokens and the end-to-end latency, to help with service capacity and concurrency planning.
map.吞吐 = tokens / 秒；单请求吞吐 = tokens / (秒 × 并发: Throughput = tokens / second; single-request throughput = tokens / (seconds x concurrent batch)
map.推理服务的核心指标：总吞吐衡量集群利用率，单请求吞吐才是用户感知的快慢。batc: Core metrics of an inference service: total throughput measures cluster utilization, while single-request throughput is the speed users perceive. Batching significantly raises total throughput but lengthens single-request latency, so online services usually need to trade off between the two according to the SLO.
map.吞吐≈生成 token 数 / 端到端时延(tokens/s)，衡量服务处理速度: Throughput is about the number of generated tokens divided by the end-to-end latency (tokens/s), measuring the processing speed of a service.
map.受模型大小、批大小、KV 缓存与硬件带宽共同影响，非仅由 FLOPs 决定。: It is shaped by model size, batch size, the KV cache and hardware bandwidth together, not by FLOPs alone.
map.容量规划用 吞吐×并发上限 估算峰值 QPS，需预留余量防雪崩。: For capacity planning, estimate peak QPS as throughput x concurrency limit, leaving headroom to avoid a cascade failure.
map.：生成 200 token 耗时 4s → 吞吐=50 tokens/s。若单卡: : Generating 200 tokens takes 4 s, so throughput = 50 tokens/s. If one card supports 4 concurrent requests each at 50 tok/s, total throughput is about 200 tok/s; but the KV cache and bandwidth are shared in practice, so the concurrency gain is sublinear.
map.为什么吞吐不随并发线性增长？: Why does throughput not grow linearly with concurrency?
map.显存带宽与算力是共享瓶颈，多请求竞争 KV 缓存与计算单元，边际吞吐递减；需实测: Memory bandwidth and compute are shared bottlenecks; multiple requests compete for the KV cache and compute units, so marginal throughput decreases. Find the inflection point by measurement before setting the concurrency limit.
map.首 token 延迟和吞吐冲突吗？: Do first-token latency and throughput conflict?
map.常冲突。大模型首 token 受预填充耗时影响，吞吐受解码并行影响；优化方向相反: They often conflict. The first token of a large model is affected by prefill time, while throughput is affected by decode parallelism; when the optimization directions conflict, choose according to the business need (chat needs low latency, batch processing needs high throughput).
